title: Zach Bryan Announces New Project Featuring Song With Lana Del Rey: Here’s When It Arrives
summary: Young Manhood & Other Donatable Organs also has a collab with Turnpike Troubadours.
contentText:
Zach Bryan is treating fans to a new batch of songs — one of which features Lana Del Rey — and it’s coming sooner than you think.

Related

Lana Del Rey Teases She Has a New Collab Coming With Zach Bryan: ‘We Finally Got Our Song Done’

The country-Americana singer-songwriter announced on Monday (Oct. 12) that he’ll be dropping an eight-track set titled Young Manhood & Other Donatable Organs on Friday (Oct. 16). “Love you guys very much and hope you enjoy it,” he wrote. “Thanks for a great year on the road.”

Bryan also shared the project’s cover art — a photo of himself standing in an open field, smiling as his lookalike points a rifle at him — and tracklist. In addition to his song with Del Rey, which is titled “Lies,” it’ll feature tracks called “Lodi When,” “Robot Killed the Working Man,” “Dog Days,” “Backwards,” “Plainsman” featuring Turnpike Troubadours, “Is the Blue Tangled in You?” and “You’ll Get By.”

The news comes just 10 months after Bryan dropped his most recent album, With Heaven On Top , which debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 . He kicked off his With Heaven on Tour in March, traveling through stadiums and arenas across Europe and North America before wrapping the trek on Saturday (Oct. 10) in Auburn, Ala.

Del Rey previously teased that she and Bryan had a finished collaboration in the tank. “Whale, we finally got our song done. And that’s no Lie,” she wrote on Instagram in September, sharing a clip of the “Something in the Orange” singer in a studio and subtly teasing the track’s title.
